result.summary: Backports six pull requests to the 32.x release branch: #36277, #36303, #36340, #36392, #36404, and #36435. The changes include ensuring initial private broadcast connections are fully made and retries are properly tracked, capping the socket wait timeout to fix zero-timeout RPC clients on macOS and BSD systems, improving HTTP receive throttling test logging, and fixing CI/test isolation and fuzzing issues.
result.problem: The 32.x branch lacks several fixes already merged on master: private broadcast can fail to complete its intended initial connections or trigger stale retries; running `bitcoin-cli` with `-rpcclienttimeout=0` errors out on macOS because large timeouts cause `select()` to fail with EINVAL; concurrent CI container jobs collide over Docker subnets; and the private broadcast fuzz test fails to explore state due to hardcoded zero-seeding.
evidence: Commit b2c6f6f027: 'bitcoin-cli turns -rpcclienttimeout=0 into a 5 year timeout and passes it down to Sock::Wait. On systems without poll() (e.g. macOS and the BSDs) the wait is done with select(), which fails with EINVAL for timeouts above 10^8 seconds on macOS... Cap the timeout at INT_MAX milliseconds'

Commit 3c61fa20ef: 'Make sure we send out all three connections when intiating a private broadcast. Use MarkResolved instead of Remove to mark a tx as having been received back or mempool-conflicted. Prevent additional stale retry connections by tracking disconnects and explicitly granting new connections with TryGrantRetry.'
result.scope_notes: This is a batch backport PR consisting of 9 cherry-picked commits from 6 merged PRs targeting the 32.x release branch.
result.changed_since_previous: The PR was expanded from a single backport (#36404) to include five additional backports: #36277 (private broadcast connection fixes), #36303 (HTTP byte logging and test updates), #36340 (socket wait timeout capping for macOS), #36392 (test shutdown cleanup), and #36435 (CI container network isolation).
result.card: Backports six pull requests to the 32.x release branch (#36277, #36303, #36340, #36392, #36404, #36435). Key fixes include ensuring private broadcast completes all three initial peer connections while avoiding stale retries, and capping Sock::WaitMany timeouts so bitcoin-cli -rpcclienttimeout=0 functions properly on macOS and BSD without select() rejecting the large timeout. Additional commits isolate CI container networks, resolve private broadcast fuzz seeding, and enhance HTTP throttling tests.

risk.why: Touches P2P private broadcast connection dispatching and generic socket polling timeout handling; a bug could disrupt peer connectivity or private transaction relay on the release branch.
